items.title: Diagnose wrapper-root gitRoot candidates deterministically
items.context: When metadataRoot itself is not a git repository and no explicit gitRoot is configured, diagnostics should identify the exact state: zero candidates, one candidate with an explicit repair suggestion, or multiple candidates with a fail-closed ambiguity message. This is a real correctness UX issue because story_resolve/review_run_start currently fail with a stable but manual-only error in parent-metadata/child-repo layouts.
items.userSees: lattice config doctor reports metadataRoot is not git-backed and, when exactly one child git repo exists, prints a concrete gitRoot suggestion and repair command.
excludes: using the suggested child repo automatically for signed-workspace resolution

items.title: Add explicit confirmed gitRoot repair command
items.context: Provide a CLI repair path that requires an explicit gitRoot value and confirmation, validates the target stays under metadataRoot and is git-backed, writes only the config field, and reports the verification result. This should be deterministic and usable by any host shell without making the host authoritative.
items.userSees: lattice config repair --set-git-root=clawcreek --confirm writes gitRoot and reports that the configured git root resolves successfully.

items.title: Verify repair unblocks signed-workspace resolution
items.context: Add regression coverage for a wrapper-root project with one child git repo and no gitRoot, then run the repair command and verify story_resolve/review_run_start can resolve the git-backed signed workspace. Also verify ambiguous multiple-child layouts remain fail-closed.
items.userSees: After repair, story_resolve/review_run_start no longer report metadata_root_is_not_git_and_no_worktree_or_gitRoot_is_configured for the repaired project.
